description: This file contains utility functions for reading a file into memory and printing its content or output data, primarily used for testing purposes in unit tests. It includes a function to read a file into memory with error handling and a function to print the content either from a file or provided data.

methods.name: int read_file_into_memory(const char * filename,test_ut_memory_t * pInstance)
methods.description: Reads the contents of a specified file into a memory buffer within a test utility structure, with error handling for common file I/O issues.

methods.name: void print_input_output(char * kvpData,const char * filename)
methods.description: Prints the content of a file and/or a string data buffer for test output inspection.
